Interface: input clk, rst_n; input in_valid, input out_ready, input [1:0] in_data; output in_ready, output out_valid, output [1:0] out_data
Specification: One-entry elastic ready/valid buffer, no combinational data bypass. Async active-low rst_n clears occupancy and data. While reset is low force in_ready=0, out_valid=0 and out_data=0. Otherwise in_ready = !occupied || out_ready, out_valid=occupied, out_data=stored data (zero when empty). At a rising edge use pre-edge occupied and out_ready: if in_valid && in_ready, store in_data and set occupied=1, including simultaneous consume/replace. module elastic_slot (
    input  logic       clk,
    input  logic       rst_n,
    input  logic       in_valid,
    input  logic       out_ready,
    input  logic [1:0] in_data,
    output logic       in_ready,
    output logic       out_valid,
    output logic [1:0] out_data
);

    logic       occupied;
    logic [1:0] stored_data;

    always_comb begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            in_ready = 1'b0;
            out_valid = 1'b0;
            out_data = 2'b00;
        end else begin
            in_ready = !occupied || out_ready;
            out_valid = occupied;
            out_data = occupied ? stored_data : 2'b00;
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            occupied <= 1'b0;
            stored_data <= 2'b00;
        end else if (in_valid && in_ready) begin
            occupied <= 1'b1;
            stored_data <= in_data;
        end else if (occupied && out_ready) begin
            occupied <= 1'b0;
            stored_data <= 2'b00;
        end
    end

endmodule
